summary_for_children: Al-Muddaththir tells the Prophet (peace be upon him) to arise and warn, glorify his Lord, purify his clothes and be patient.
environment_concept: Sunrise over a home (74:2) and a washing place with clean cloth (74:4).
architecture_and_scenery: A home at dawn with a washing place.

activities.name: Morning routine
activities.description: Carry three jars of clean water to the washing place.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The Prophet (peace be upon him) is never shown.

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (basin, horizon, house) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A windy green hillside above a village with a stream, a flat washing stone, a basket of garments and a drying line

primary_mechanic.text: Wash three garments step by step: soak, scrub, rinse until the rinse water runs clear (four rinses; wringing while it is still cloudy is refused), wring and hang on the line (74:4, and your clothing purify). Steps out of order are refused.

secondary_activities: by the moon and the dawn (74:32-34, read across the stream)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading under the oaks, the washing stone, then a reading at the lookout over the bridge
environment_behaviour: clean garments hang on the line
the rinse water clears with each rinse
unique_world.learning_objective: Know the surah’s first commands, among them purify your clothing (74:1-7)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: A Call to Responsibility
story_library.children_narration: Surah Al-Muddaththir begins with a call to rise and warn. It teaches about sincerity, personal responsibility, and not becoming proud of one's efforts. The surah also includes serious warnings about rejecting truth and neglecting those in need.

world_idea.title: The Dawn of Responsibility
world_idea.description: Explore a landscape moving from darkness to daylight and complete activities about keeping shared spaces clean, caring for others, and acting sincerely.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
